title: Achieving a stable 518 Wh kg−1 Li metal pouch cell via SEI reconstruction engineering for high Li+ conductive hetero-grain boundaries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9240-9253
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02670A, Paper
Zhongwei Jiang, Junyang Liu, Ke Yue, Man Pang, Yixuan Peng, Chongyang Luo, Ziqing Yao, Tao Pan, Yuanyuan Wang, Yujie Li, Qingpeng Guo, Chunman Zheng, Weiwei Sun, Xinyong Tao, Shuangke Liu
A SEI reconstruction method on Li anodes via perfluoroether carboxylic acid spraying, yielding a LiF/Li2O-rich SEI with high Li+ conductive hetero-grain boundaries, enabling a 5.8 Ah pouch cell to achieve 518 Wh kg−1 and 100 cycles.
